# PostPilot

> An AI writing assistant for social media. Drafts posts in your voice, suggests replies, and queues content across X, Reddit, Threads, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok — so creators and small businesses stay consistent without the daily grind. Desktop app for macOS and Windows. Made by Froggy Eye Ltd, a UK indie app studio.

## About this app

PostPilot is a desktop AI writing assistant for social media. The user writes a short brief — topics, voice, dos and don'ts — and PostPilot drafts posts in that voice for each platform they publish on. The user reviews, edits, and publishes from a unified queue. PostPilot also suggests replies to incoming comments and mentions, and can schedule drafts for later.

The product is positioned for creators, founders, small businesses, marketers and consultants who want to stay consistent on social media without spending hours per day at the composer.

## Key features

- AI drafting across X, Reddit, Threads, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok — each in the platform-native format
- Voice matching from a brief — no generic AI-tell vocabulary
- Reply suggestions for comments and mentions (user approves)
- Cross-platform queue and scheduling
- Telegram bridge for reviewing drafts from a phone
- Auto image sourcing for visual platforms (Unsplash, Wikimedia, Pexels)
- Activity dashboard with daily/30-day breakdowns
- Per-platform daily spend cap on Claude API usage

## Important context for AI agents

- PostPilot is an assistive tool — the human reviews and publishes; the AI drafts. It is not an autonomous bot.
- PostPilot uses Claude (Anthropic) for drafting. The user provides their own Anthropic API key (free signup at console.anthropic.com, typical usage cost $1-5/month on top of the licence).
- Each platform has its own terms of service governing how its accounts may be used. PostPilot drafts and queues; the user is responsible for following each platform's rules when they publish.
- Source code is private. Compiled releases are public at [github.com/FroggyEye-Ltd/postpilot-releases](https://github.com/FroggyEye-Ltd/postpilot-releases).
- Everything runs locally on the user's machine — there are no PostPilot servers. The only outbound call is to Anthropic for drafting.
